lesson.title: Registration form: spelling, names and numbers

learning_objectives.en: Complete a course enrolment form and reject self-corrected dates.
learning_objectives.vi: Điền biểu mẫu đăng ký lớp học, tránh bẫy ngày tháng được sửa.

content.en: Write a surname as spelled; choose acceptable number/date forms according to the limit. When a date is corrected, use the revised date.
content.vi: Viết họ theo đánh vần; dùng định dạng số/ngày đúng giới hạn; khi ngày được sửa, lấy ngày cuối.

vocabulary.example_en: Equipment hire is included in the morning session.
vocabulary.example_vi: Dịch vụ thuê dụng cụ đã bao gồm trong buổi sáng.

strategies.en: Guess whether each blank needs name, date, fee, room or time. Keep listening after an apparently complete answer.
strategies.vi: Đoán ô cần tên, ngày, phí, phòng hay giờ; tiếp tục nghe sau thông tin có vẻ đã đầy đủ.

mini_review.en: Can you write the final start date after hearing the earlier wrong date?
mini_review.vi: Bạn có ghi đúng ngày khai giảng sau khi nghe thông tin cũ bị sửa?

audios.title: Enrolling on an evening course
audios.transcript:
Receptionist: Ashford Community College, enrolment desk. How can I help?
Caller: Hello, I’d like to sign up for one of your evening courses – the photography one.
Receptionist: We have two photography courses: Beginners and Next Steps. Which one are you interested in?
Caller: Beginners, please. I’ve only used my phone camera so far.
Receptionist: That’s fine – phone cameras are welcome on that course. Can I have your full name?
Caller: It’s David Marsh. M-A-R-S-H.
Receptionist: Thank you. And your date of birth?
Caller: The fourteenth of March, nineteen eighty-seven.
Receptionist: Lovely. The course runs on Wednesdays, starting on the second of October. Oh, sorry – I’m looking at last year’s timetable. It actually starts on the ninth of October this year, and it lasts ten weeks.
Caller: What time does it begin?
Receptionist: Half past six, and each session is two hours. You’ll be in room twelve in the Arts building.
Caller: And how much does it cost?
Receptionist: The full fee is seventy-five pounds. Are you over sixty, or receiving any benefits?
Caller: No, neither.
Receptionist: Then it’s seventy-five. That includes printing for your final exhibition, but you’ll need to buy a memory card if you use a separate camera.
Caller: OK. Can I pay by card over the phone?
Receptionist: Yes, or you can pay in person at the library desk. Lastly, how did you hear about the course?
Caller: A friend recommended it. She did the cookery course last spring.
Receptionist: Wonderful. I’ll email you a confirmation today. What’s your email address?
Caller: It’s dmarsh at lightmail dot com.
Receptionist: Perfect. See you in October, David.

audios.title: Sports shop: price and equipment table
audios.transcript: Welcome to the sports equipment desk. I will give you the current prices for five popular items. A new badminton racket costs twenty-six pounds, not the old price of twenty-nine. The pack of shuttlecocks is nine pounds. We also have basketballs for eighteen pounds each. A pair of football boots is usually forty-two pounds, but this week the sale price is thirty-six pounds, so please use thirty-six in your notes. For table tennis, a set of two bats costs twenty-two pounds. Finally, a skipping rope costs six pounds. Let me repeat the final prices: badminton racket, twenty-six; shuttlecocks, nine; basketball, eighteen; football boots, thirty-six; two table tennis bats, twenty-two; skipping rope, six. These are all prices in pounds.

instruction.en: Listen to U02_Listening_2. Complete the notes with NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER.
instruction.vi: Nghe U02_Listening_2. Điền không quá hai từ và/hoặc một con số.

questions.explanation_en: The caller chooses Beginners instead of Next Steps.
questions.explanation_vi: Người gọi chọn Beginners, không chọn Next Steps.

questions.explanation_en: The second was last year; the ninth is the corrected date.
questions.explanation_vi: Ngày 2 là năm trước; ngày 9 mới là ngày được sửa.

questions.prompt_en: The course was recommended by a ____.
questions.explanation_en: The caller heard about the course from a friend.
questions.explanation_vi: Người gọi biết khóa học do bạn giới thiệu.

instruction.en: Listen to U02_Listening_5. Fill each price in pounds. Use a NUMBER only. Be careful: two earlier prices are corrected.
instruction.vi: Nghe U02_Listening_5 và điền giá bằng bảng Anh. Chỉ dùng SỐ. Cẩn thận hai giá cũ bị sửa.

questions.explanation_en: The old £29 is rejected; the final price is £26.
questions.explanation_vi: Giá cũ 29 bảng bị thay bằng 26 bảng.

questions.explanation_en: £42 is the usual price, but the sale price is £36.
questions.explanation_vi: 42 bảng là giá thường; giá khuyến mãi 36 bảng.

questions.prompt_en: Price of two table tennis bats: £____
questions.explanation_en: A set of two bats costs £22.
